item.title: Attorney General Ellison reaches settlement with Saint Paul nonprofit and its president in lawsuit over misuse of charitable funds, governance failures
item.description:
Publication Date: September 03, 2026

Settlement bans Act for Cause president, Rajesh Mehta, from nonprofit sector for 20 years and requires Mehta to pay $200,000 in civil fines for his breaches of fiduciary duties. Act for Cause will remain a dissolved entity under the settlement.
